name: Atmospheric Beasts
description: Atmospheric beasts are hypothetical organisms proposed to inhabit Earth's upper atmosphere permanently, never landing, drifting or flying in air currents — an idea rooted in the writings of Charles Fort and systematized by zoologist Ivan T. Sanderson as an alternative explanation for some UFO reports.

aliases.name: Sky Beasts
aliases.meaning: Alternative term for atmospheric organisms living in the upper atmosphere

aliases.name: Sky Critters
aliases.meaning: Term used by Trevor James Constable for amoeba-like aerial organisms he claimed to photograph

aliases.name: Cloud Beasts
aliases.meaning: Informal term for proposed atmospheric lifeforms resembling drifting cloud formations

aliases.name: Space Critters
aliases.meaning: Broader term encompassing atmospheric or interplanetary proposed lifeforms

aliases.name: Aerial Organisms
aliases.meaning: Neutral scientific-style term for the hypothetical creatures

origin: The hypothesis proposes a global atmospheric distribution, with no specific geographic restriction. Reported sightings associated with atmospheric beasts come from multiple continents.
